newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary BSE to change CESI index basket on May 2.
newsitem.headline: Hungary BSE to change CESI index basket on May 2.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Friday that it revised the share basket of the Central European Share Index (CESI) effective on May 2.
The number of the shares in the CESI basket will drop to 72 from the current 73 on May 2, the BSE said in a statement.
The basket consists of the largest, most liquid and officially listed stocks traded on the Bratislava, Budapest, Ljubjana, Prague and Warsaw stock exchanges.
The new basket, containing 10 Hungarian, 10 Slovenian, 7 Slovak, 12 Czech and 33 Polish shares, represented 71 percent of the total market capitalisation of the five bourses as of 28 March.
The BSE said that the value of the new basket's "K" corrective factor, which allows comparison with the previous CESI indices, will be published on April 30.
The CESI closed at 1,494.91 points on Friday, down 5.50 points.
